items.text: Two PBs at Saturday's session — Carla took ten seconds off her farmers carry and Josh finally broke the sled.
Welcome to Priya and Dan, straight in at Tuesday — first session nerves don't survive the warm-up here.
Josh turns forty on Friday — cake after Sunday run club, bring your knees.
Manchester race entries close Sunday night — names on the board by then or it's next round.
Six of you are eyeing the same Birmingham weekend — the travel board's open, pair up before the trains go up.
And Katie — happy birthday for Tuesday. Your 7am's in the book; I'll bring the coffee and croissants on the way in.

followUp.text: The pic: me and Katie, coffee and croissants after the 7am. I keep my promises.
